records.title: Thinking with Looped Flows
records.reason: The paper trains recurrent latent states along a flow trajectory and evaluates algorithmic reasoning (Sudoku, maze, ARC, N-Queens, graph coloring), including inference-time ODE/SDE ablations. It is not an LLM method and uses repeated flow steps; language-model transfer remains unshown.
